Home/Products/Hexagonal Wire Mesh 13mm (1/2")

Overview

Standard hexagonal wire mesh 13mm aperture, galvanized. Used for plastering, animal cages, and decoration.

Product Description

Our hexagonal wire mesh is manufactured using high-quality low carbon steel wires woven into a hexagonal pattern. Available in various mesh sizes and wire gauges for different applications. **Product Features:** - Mesh Type: Triple twist hexagonal mesh - Mesh Size: 13mm (1/2") - Wire Diameter: 0.5-0.9mm - Width: 1.0m / 1.2m / 1.5m - Length: 30m standard roll - Surface: Electro galvanized or hot-dipped galvanized **Applications:** - Plastering mesh (rendering reinforcement) - Animal enclosures and cages - Decoration and crafts - Gardening and landscaping - Insulation wrapping
